text:
Asha CSM: seeing a pattern: small accounts using only 1 endpoint and dropping token regen. proposing a compact 'micro-save' heuristic we can run fast on 10 accounts. idea: two-step check + light concession. thoughts? :mag:

Ben AM: sounds promising. two-step?

Asha CSM: step A: single-question outreach + 10m triage to classify blocker (integration, feature gap, cost). step B: if integration or confusion -> immediate snippet + 48h endpoint bump; if cost -> one-off credit offer tied to re-activation. keep all touches <2 weeks.

Rina Enablement: I can do 10m triages. request: share a one-slide checklist and a ready-to-go snippet pack.

Kofi Ops: automation sketch (SaveBot) looks safe if we add billing & rate guards. example rule:
````
trigger: low_depth_alert
conditions: billing_current AND health>=30
actions: ping:CSM+Enablement -> schedule:10m -> grant_temp_bump:48h -> log:pulse_response
````
I'll bump to staging with rate limits.

SaveBot: draft automation queued. will not apply concessions if invoices>30d or concessions_qtr>=1.

Ben AM: messaging tone: "we noticed less activity and want to help" + one clear CTA. I'll draft two short variants.

Asha CSM: action items:
- Asha: pick 10 accounts + send kickoff (today)
- Rina: prep checklist + snippet pack (12h)
- Ben: two outreach variants (4h)
- Kofi/SaveBot: staging dry-run + report (24h)

Asha CSM: goal: low-effort saves and clear signal for product. if works, scale to next 100. :seedling:
